# OvZuno

OvZuno is a B2B technology publisher creating focused publications for builders, operators, and technology decision-makers.

Publications:
- AI Infrastructure: https://aiinfra.ovzuno.com/
- Crypto: https://crypto.ovzuno.com/
- Workplace: https://workplace.ovzuno.com/

Editorial standards: https://ovzuno.com/editorial-standards/
Publication disclosure: https://ovzuno.com/publication-disclosure/
Contact: editor@ovzuno.com

Status: pre-launch; pages are not intended for search indexing.
